native_checks_not_exhaustively_executed: Missing/ambiguous-reference rejection and automatic-calibration cancellation during all native host transitions.
Conclusive zero-compensation validity through native save/reopen.
Native CPU profiling, all Session Record/configuration races, other hardware/OS/sample rates and musical vocal-accuracy distributions.
limits: Amplitude onset detection can count keyboard/room sounds and speaker bleed; it does not classify syllables or musical intent.
Calibration measures relative digital-reference/acoustic-return delay, not recorded-clip placement.
Relevant audio-path changes require manual recalibration; valid saved compensation is reused rather than automatically reacquired each take.
Offline models and owner-observed native checks are separate evidence.
privacy: No owner audio, Live Sets, screenshots or raw routing/input dumps are included.
